newsitem.title: USA: Two Texas boys charged with rape of 4-year-old girl.
newsitem.headline: Two Texas boys charged with rape of 4-year-old girl.

text.p: Two boys, ages 10 and 14, were being held Thursday on charges they raped a 4-year-old girl.
The boys were arrested Sunday when police found them in a school bus with the girl, said Texas City police captain Ronald Berg.
"They were in the process of trying to pull their pants up .. the little girl was in the bus, crying," Berg said.
"She was definitely in the process of being sexually assaulted," he said.

Berg said the girl lived near one of the boys and was lured into the bus, parked in a school parking lot, on the premise they were taking her to a carnival. The boys had duct tape and cloth, apparently to tie the girl up, but it had not been used, he said.
Berg said the boys were being held by Galveston County juvenile authorities on charges of aggravated sexual assault of a child.
A hearing was scheduled Friday to determine if the 14-year-old could be tried as an adult, he said.
Berg said he did not know the current condition of the girl.
Texas City is an industrial town about 35 miles (56 km) southeast of Houston.
